name: agreeableness
quote: Always a good helper, that lad.
description: A pattern of consistently displaying pro-social behaviors.
perceptions: Being friendly and helpful to others has generally been a good strategy for me.

guidance.description: Agreeableness is one of the 'Big 5' personality traits recognized by psychologists. It's considered to be a spectrum from 'agreeableness' on one end to 'disagreeableness' on the other.

In this article, I’ll cover how to be agreeable in a healthy way, and by the end of the article, I’ll explain the difference between being agreeable (usually good) and being submissive (usually not that good).
Are You Too Agreeable? 7 Strategies To Push Back Without Coming Off Pushy

commentaries.quote: If you are too agreeable, you may get stepped on like a doormat.
Agreeableness is of fundamental importance to psychological well-being, predicting mental health, positive affect, and good relations with others.
commentaries.attribution: KM DeNeve & C Cooper in 'The happy personality: A metaanalysis of 137 personality traits and subjective well-being'

commentaries.quote: Criticism may not be agreeable, but it is necessary. It fulfils the same function as pain in the human body. It calls attention to an unhealthy state of things.
